<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pcenter(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='p' and n['pixels']==9:
            b=n['boundary']
            rows=[q[0] for q in b]; cols=[q[1] for q in b]
            return (round((min(rows)+max(rows))/2,1), round((min(cols)+max(cols))/2,1))
    return None

start = pcenter(current_frame)
print('start center:', start)
r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':43,'col':20}])
c1 = pcenter(current_frame)
print('after click (43,20):', c1, 'bar_changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
if c1 != (43.0,20.0):
    r2 = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':18}])
    c2 = pcenter(current_frame)
    print('after fallback click (45,18):', c2)
print('final center:', pcenter(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
